risks.risk: The camera does not power on or its functions do not work.
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing it on the LCD.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working body for parts or repair.

risks.risk: Shutter count or actuator wear is unknown.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from the camera service menu or a computer tool connected via USB.

risks.risk: The image sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as sensor requiring cleaning or repair.

risks.risk: Autofocus, buttons, dials, or the screen may be defective.
risks.proof: Video showing every button and dial being used, the screen displaying menus, and autofocus locking on a subject.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with functions untested and possibly defective.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, or memory card may be missing or dead.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery, charger, and memory card, plus a video of the camera running on the battery.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without battery, charger, or memory card.

risks.risk: Original box, manuals, and accessories may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the box, manuals, strap, cables, and any other accessories.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in the three angles, such as top LCD, hot shoe, or side ports.
risks.proof: Photos of the top plate, hot shoe, side ports, and all remaining exterior angles.

risks.risk: Warranty status is unknown or the item is grey market.
risks.proof: Warranty card, purchase receipt, or Canon service status screenshot.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo
Photo of the sensor at f/16 against a white wall
Photo of the battery, charger, and memory card
Photos of the top plate, hot shoe, and side ports
